versionSemantics.major: For ABI 1.x and later, a change permits breaks only at a new major. ABI 0 is experimental and does not provide this guarantee between minors.
versionSemantics.minorBefore1: A reviewed ABI generation that may be additive or incompatible; never accepted as a same-major range.
versionSemantics.minorAfter1: Additive and backward-compatible within the major.
versionSemantics.patch: ABI-neutral fixes only: no export, prototype, layout, constant, callback, ownership, error, or semantic contract change. Exact patch releases still require matrix admission because the native metadata carries no shape fingerprint.

validation.requiredSymbols: every LibraryImport entry point in CNA.Interop.Native
runtimeCanaries: cna_touch_capabilities_init 16-byte version-1 layout, canonical body, and write bounds
buildTimeEvidence: upstream ABI baseline/history diff (tools/coverage/baselinediff.py with eng/cna-upstream-abi-allowlist.txt), which must report zero unreviewed breaking differences between an already-accepted generation and the proposed one

acceptedVersions.evidence: Consumer baseline at CNA next bdf239360 (0.35.0 plus CBIND-128, which DrawableGameComponent.GraphicsDevice from game-driven component callbacks needs; an older 0.35.0 library fails that one integration test with InvalidState). tools/coverage/baselinediff.py 0.21.0 (599d14e54) -> 0.35.0 (bdf239360): 957 consumed exports, 0 absent, 0 changed prototype; 1048 upstream removals/changes of surface this binding does not import or mirror, reviewed in eng/cna-upstream-abi-allowlist.txt (36 entries, 0 stale). tools/abi-verify against the 0.35.0 headers: 895 native and 895 managed layout/type measurements with 0 mismatches other than abi.version itself before this admission, 957 of 957 prototypes compiled, 6 callbacks checked, 350 enum-like constants asserted, 12 of 12 negative controls rejected. The header documentation of all 957 consumed routes was diffed 0.21.0 -> 0.35.0: 14 changed contracts, of which three needed managed changes (Clear(Color) now uses XNA's DefaultClearOptions and depth 1.0 because clear_options refuses a missing plane; ShaderDialect gained HLSL/MSL/WGSL/SPIR-V) and the rest are refusals XNA itself makes (Reach-profile limits, occlusion-query sequencing, whole-frame audio buffers). Native integration 200/200 in Debug and Release against build-probe (OPENGLES3, CNA_EASYGL_COMPILED_EFFECTS=ON).

Superseded by 0.20.0. Nothing this consumer touches differs between them; the entry was retired rather than kept so the matrix stays a reviewed point list instead of accumulating into a range.

Superseded by 0.21.0. Nothing this consumer touches differs between them -- the step adds three exports, one scalar and three constants and removes or changes nothing -- so the entry was retired rather than kept, for the same reason 0.19.0 was: a point matrix that accumulated every generation it had ever accepted would stop being a review and start being a range.

Superseded by 0.35.0. CNA removed 44 routes this binding imported (the engine-layer post-process, bloom, tonemap, render-target-pool and blit routes, retired upstream in 0.30.0 as MOD-RETIRE-1); the binding dropped them with the CNA.Graphics.Experimental layer that wrapped them. Every route it still imports existed in 0.21.0 with the same prototype, so a 0.21.0 library would pass every symbol and shape probe -- it is refused on the version rule alone, which the retired-0.21.0 fixture proves.
